tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the contents of a file from the local filesystem at the given absolute path, returning the UTF-8-decoded text. Fails if the file is missing or not UTF-8 decodable.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create or overwrite a file at the given absolute path with the given UTF-8 content. Returns the number of bytes written. Fails if the parent directory does not exist.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List the direct children of the given directory, non-recursively. Returns an array of file and directory names.
